# Valheim fixture provenance

These are sanitized, minimal excerpts used to freeze Hostkind's phase-0
console contract. They contain no player names, addresses, tokens, passwords,
or machine paths.

- `linux-start.log`: dedicated-server stdout from a Linux Steam build, reduced
  to the version and backend-readiness lines.
- `windows-start.log`: dedicated-server stdout from a Windows Steam build,
  reduced to the corresponding readiness line.

The fixtures intentionally do not claim a player-count grammar. Phase 0
therefore reports observed connections as unknown (`null`).
